01 / The person

A little about me.

I build products that help people understand, create, and take their next step.

I’m a senior software engineer and tech lead at LinkedIn, based in New York. I’ve led work on Creator Analytics and helped build Creator Monetization from the ground up, connecting the mobile and web experiences with the APIs and data behind them.

Before LinkedIn, I built native Android account-opening flows at Capital One. I studied computer science and music technology at Virginia Tech, and I still make time to make beats. I care about the details, seeing things through, and making something useful for the people on the other side of the screen.
